messages:
nina: Quick share  tiny goal+feedback crib that folks can paste into reviews. Kept to one-liners so it's easy to scan.

omar: Nice. Can we include a benefits/policy line for people who led policy work?
tess: yes please  example would help.
nina: added a short policy/benefit KR and a manager tag line. Draft below.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: review window opens Monday. Use thread if you want it added to templates.

nina: --- ONE-LINE OBJECTIVE ---
- Objective: "Improve reliability of hosted API for enterprise customers."

nina: --- KEY RESULTS (one-line each) ---
- KR (metric): "Reduce customer-facing error rate from 2.5% to 0.5% on high-throughput routes."
- KR (adoption): "Increase dedicated-seat onboarding to 80% completion in first week."
- KR (policy/benefit): "Document and roll out data-handling flow to meet new SOC2 requirement; reduce manual review time by 70%."

nina: --- SELF-REVIEW SNIPPET (pasteable, 3 lines max) ---
- "Owned rollout of per-tenant isolation; reduced incidents for enterprise tier by X% and shortened mean time-to-recover."

nina: --- MANAGER SNIPE (2 lines) ---
- "Delivered strong execution on isolation and docs; measurable drop in incidents.
- Next step: scale runbook and assign a 3-week follow-up to validate handoffs."

nina: --- PEER DM TEMPLATE (one line) ---
- "Hey @NAME  quick favor: 1-2 lines on how my handoff/readability was during the isolation rollout? Thx!"

omar: This is clean. I'll paste into my team's review guide.
tess: Love the SOC2 line  will use for policy leads. Thanks!
